description:
Company Overview:

We are building Protege to solve the biggest unmet need in AI — getting access to the right training data. The process today is time intensive, incredibly expensive, and often ends in failure. The Protege platform facilitates the secure, efficient, and privacy-centric exchange of AI training data.

Solving AI’s data problem is a generational opportunity. We’re backed by world-class investors and already powering partnerships with some of the most ambitious teams in AI. The company that succeeds will be one of the largest in AI — and in tech.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, high-trust team of builders who are obsessed with velocity and impact. Our culture is built for people who thrive on ambiguity, own outcomes, and want to shape the future of data and AI.

The role

Our infrastructure team runs the systems the rest of Protege depends on: cloud infrastructure, security, and IT. We hold sensitive health data for our partners, so those systems have to be secure as well as reliable. They also have to keep up as the team grows.

You’ll be our first dedicated IT hire. You’ll own laptops, identity, SaaS apps, onboarding and offboarding, and IT support for the whole company. You’ll report to Richard Ho, one of our co-founders, and work closely with our security and infrastructure engineers, People, and Finance. The hard part is building the function while running it. Requests keep arriving while you put the foundations in place, most of the team works remotely, and people here adopt new AI tools every week. Your job is to make access fast to grant and fast to remove, and to keep every laptop and account at the standard our data requires.

What you'll do

  • Take over IT support for the whole company. Every request comes through one intake, gets tracked, and gets a first response within one business day.

  • Own MDM and endpoint security across our Mac fleet. Every laptop is enrolled, encrypted, patched, and running the security tools our security engineer requires.

  • Expand Okta SSO across our SaaS apps. People sign in once with MFA, and access is granted and removed in one place.

  • Automate onboarding and offboarding. New hires start with a configured laptop and working accounts on day one, and departing employees lose access the day they leave.

  • Run the laptop lifecycle through a vendor. Laptops ship to new hires already set up and come back to be wiped, and we always know who has which device.

  • Automate routine requests. Password resets with identity checks, access requests, and other common asks are self-serve or automated, including with AI tools, so support work doesn’t grow with headcount.

  • Track our SaaS apps and spend with Finance. Every tool has an owner and a known cost, and we stop paying for what we don’t use.

What success looks like

  • 30 days: Learned our Okta and Google Workspace setup, met People, Finance, and Security, took over the IT request queue, and started an MDM pilot.

  • 60 days: Owning onboarding and offboarding end to end, with accounts created automatically from our HR system and laptops shipped already enrolled.

  • 90 days: Every laptop is enrolled in MDM, our 15 most-used apps are behind SSO with MFA, and departing employees lose access the same day.

What you'll bring

  • Built or rebuilt IT at a startup or fast-growing company: rolled out an MDM, moved apps onto SSO, and set up onboarding and offboarding

  • Run a remote Mac fleet with an MDM such as Jamf, Kandji, or Fleet, plus Apple Business Manager, including shipping and recovering laptops

  • Administered Okta and Google Workspace, including SAML, SCIM, and automated provisioning from an HR system

  • Written scripts or automations (bash, Python, Okta Workflows, or APIs) that replaced manual IT work

  • Treated device and identity work as security work, for example by enforcing encryption or MFA, or by cutting back admin access

  • Nice to have: Worked in a SOC 2 or HIPAA environment

  • Nice to have: Automated IT support with AI tools, or managed SaaS configuration as code

How we work

Remote-first, high trust, high candor. Six values guide how we operate:

  • Pass the Loved Ones' Test. Do the right thing, especially when it is hard and no one is watching.

  • Always Find a Way. Be resourceful and push through obstacles.

  • Go Fast and Grow Fast. Move with urgency, learn quickly, keep improving.

  • Practice Kindness and Candor. Say the honest thing, with care.

  • Deliver Together. Win as one team.

  • Own the Outcome. Hone the Craft. Sweat the details and raise the bar.
